subject: English
passage: In a hypothetical literary tradition, the earliest collection contains several stories about a legendary ruler but no account of a flood, whereas a later compilation includes a flood episode alongside adaptations of those earlier stories, suggesting that ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: the two collections differ in most of their stories.
choices.B: the earlier collection could not have supplied the flood episode included in the later compilation.
choices.C: the authors of the earlier collection had never heard any flood stories.
choices.D: the later compilation is more historically accurate than the earlier collection.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer because the earlier collection contains no account of a flood. Although the later compilation adapts stories from that collection, the earlier collection could not have supplied the flood episode, which it lacks.
